notes: Site: potterybarn.in (Reliance/Fynd platform, pottery-barn.fynd.io backend). Access: direct HTTP GET throughout, no WAF/block encountered; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow and only blocks /collections* (plural) which none of the URLs used here match. Checked: main header nav (single top-level 'Bestsellers' link -> /collection/pottery-barn-best-sellers, no sub-menu), footer, sitemap/collections.sitemap.xml (grepped for best/popular/top-sell/trend/favo). Found and validated one genuine sitewide Bestsellers PLP with a real cross-category product grid (filters for Bedroom Furniture etc., sortOn=popular, cursor pagination) confirming it's a real merchandising listing, not editorial. qty taken from the page's own embedded product-listing JSON field page.item_total, which exactly matches the listing that returned it (same pattern verified valid in the prior Home-Decor pass for this site: 'page':{'item_total':N} on the live product grid, distinct from an unrelated footer-widget item_total=2 also present on every page which was excluded). EXCLUDED as not genuine Bestsellers PLPs: /collection/kitchen--dining-bestselling-collections ('Bestselling Collections' hub, item_total=0, itself has zero products -- it is a marketing hub tiling out to named dinnerware product-LINE collections e.g. Cambria, Mason, Deepika, Gabriella, Mendocino, Larkin, which are product-line names, not a best-selling-products listing); /collection/best-dining-room-tables, /collection/best-dining-table, /collection/best-dining-table-set (generic-adjective SEO category landing pages using the word 'best' as marketing copy for the Dining Tables category, not the site's 'Bestsellers' merchandising concept -- excluded per the brief's 'not just a page that happens to mention bestselling products' rule). No local-language variant needed (English-only India storefront).
